requirements.title: Unformatted transfer is prohibited unless connected for unformatted input/output
requirements.definition: If the file is not connected for unformatted input/output, unformatted data transfer is prohibited.

pending.unformatted-transfer-requires-unformatte: Positive control opens FORM='UNFORMATTED' and transfers a nondefault scalar. Source-control negative omits format on a formatted connection; no required diagnostic beyond later status handling is claimed.

requirements.title: Unformatted transfer moves data without editing and sequential/direct transfer uses exactly one record
requirements.definition: During unformatted data transfer, data are transferred without editing between the file and input/output list entities; for sequential or direct access exactly one record is read or written.

pending.unformatted-transfer-without-editing: Write a nondefault integer/real unformatted and read it back into a sentinel of the same type and kind; assert the value, not representation bytes.
pending.unformatted-sequential-direct-exactly-on: Write two unformatted sequential/direct records with distinct values, read one record into sentinel targets, and assert no values from the neighboring record are consumed.

requirements.title: A file value occupies contiguous file storage units after the current position
requirements.definition: A value in the file is stored in a contiguous sequence of file storage units beginning with the unit immediately following the current file position.

pending.unformatted-value-contiguous-file-storag: No portable oracle inspects raw storage-unit contiguity or byte representation; future stream-position tests may only use positions returned by INQUIRE/POS= and same-processor readback.
pending.unformatted-value-begins-after-current-p: Use unformatted stream writes of two distinct values with positions obtained by INQUIRE(POS=); read back from returned positions and assert value order, not byte counts.

requirements.title: After each unformatted value transfer, the current position follows that value
requirements.definition: After each value is transferred, the current file position is moved immediately after the last file storage unit of the value.

pending.unformatted-position-after-each-value: For unformatted stream access, write two distinct values and use INQUIRE(POS=) after each transfer; assert the second transfer starts after the first by successful readback from saved positions, not storage-unit sizes.

requirements.title: Sequential/direct unformatted input cannot require more storage units than the record contains
requirements.definition: On input from sequential or direct access, the number of file storage units required by the input list shall be less than or equal to the number in the record.

pending.unformatted-input-list-storage-units-fit: Positive control reads the same number of same-type values that were written to a record. Source-control negative reads too many values from a short record and observes only nonzero/named status if a later status rule requires it; no specific code/IOMSG is asserted.

requirements.title: Mismatched unformatted input values are processor dependent except specified correspondences
requirements.definition: If transferred file storage units do not contain a value with the same type and type parameters as the input entity, the resulting value is processor dependent except that a complex entity may correspond to two same-kind real values and a default character entity of length n may correspond to n default characters, including characters written by formatted stream output.

pending.mismatched-unformatted-input-processor-d: No portable oracle may require a value when the file storage units contain a mismatched type/type-parameter value outside the specified exceptions.
pending.complex-input-corresponds-to-two-reals: Write two same-kind real values unformatted, then read a complex entity initialized to a distinct sentinel and assert its real and imaginary parts equal the two written values where the access mode permits the correspondence.
pending.default-character-length-n-correspondenc: Write default character data in pieces whose lengths differ from the input entity length, read a length-n default character initialized to '#', and assert the n characters are recovered.
pending.formatted-stream-chars-may-feed-unformat: Because the rule grants correspondence for characters that may have been written by formatted stream output but storage-unit representation is processor dependent, future tests may use same-processor write/read guarded by successful unformatted stream input and must not assert byte encodings.

requirements.title: Unformatted direct output must fit the record and leaves any remainder undefined
requirements.definition: For unformatted direct access output, the output list shall not specify more values than fit in the record; if the values do not fill the direct record, the remainder is undefined.

pending.unformatted-direct-output-values-fit-rec: Positive control opens a direct unformatted file with RECL large enough for the known output list and reads back the value. Source-control negative writes too many values but asserts no required diagnostic here.
pending.unformatted-direct-output-remainder-unde: No portable oracle may inspect or depend on the undefined remainder of a partially filled unformatted direct record; future tests read only written values.

requirements.title: Unformatted sequential output creates an allowed-length record not exceeding RECL
requirements.definition: For unformatted sequential access, output creates a record long enough to hold the output-list values; this length is an allowed record length for the file and does not exceed any RECL= value from the OPEN connection.

pending.unformatted-sequential-record-long-enoug: Write known values to a sequential unformatted file, rewind, read them into sentinels, and assert all values are recovered.
pending.unformatted-sequential-record-length-all: No portable oracle enumerates a processor's allowed record lengths; future tests use modest records that succeed and avoid assuming the set.
pending.unformatted-sequential-record-length-not: Open with a RECL= value known to hold a small control record, assert successful write/read for that record, and use a source-control oversized write only for status behavior owned by later error rules.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.4-12.6.4.7, execution of a data transfer statement (batch162). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds. Round 1 found that the '*', INPUT_UNIT and OUTPUT_UNIT equality facets were planned through stdin/stdout capture and separate controls, which cannot observe unit identity; they are now recorded as having no portable oracle because 12.5.4 makes connecting one file to several units, and I/O through them, processor dependent, and neither NAME= nor NUMBER= rescues it. Source accounting only.
